summary: Generic expansion-wave scaffolding contract for downstream projects entering their next module expansion batch.

contracts.summary: Use this contract when a downstream project leaves its current closed batch and enters the next module expansion wave.

moduleArchetypes.summary: Runtime/service/config capability work should default to functional closure and not inherit strict visual by default.
Host integration work should default to host guard + e2e + gate first, then upgrade to visual only when it reaches a real visible surface.
Real user-visible surfaces require visual acceptance as part of the wave exit criteria.
Workspace and handoff integrations should verify artifacts, paths, and data flow before any optional visual review.

requiredPlanningArtifacts: docs/CURRENT_BACKLOG.md 中声明当前扩展 wave 与默认验收主线
config/project-expansion-wave.json 中声明当前 wave、scope、archetype 与 acceptanceTrack
nonGoals: AIAssistant 的 Phase D strict visual 结论
